_meta.description: CompliLet WhatsApp Business message templates for Meta pre-approval.
_meta.how_to_submit: Submit each template individually via the Meta Business Manager API or Graph API. See submit-templates.sh for the curl commands.
_meta.approval_timeline: Typically 24–48 hours. Rejected templates can be resubmitted with minor wording changes.
notes: Template names must be lowercase, underscores only, max 512 chars.
Variables use {{1}}, {{2}} etc. — positional, not named.
MARKETING category templates require an opt-out button if sent to non-opted-in users.
UTILITY templates (transactional) have lower opt-out requirements.
All templates below are UTILITY unless otherwise noted.

components.text:
Hi! I'm CompliLet, the AI screening assistant for *{{1}}*.

They've asked me to help verify your details for a rental application at *{{2}}*.

This is a quick and secure process — I'll ask for a few documents and references. Ready to get started?

To complete your application, I need a photo of your *{{1}}*.

Please send a clear, well-lit photo where all four corners are visible. Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, or PDF.

If you have any questions, just reply to this message.
CompliLet · Your documents are encrypted and stored securely.

Hello,

*{{1}}* has listed you as a {{2}} reference for a rental application.

I'm CompliLet, an automated reference assistant. Could you spare 2 minutes to answer a few short questions about {{1}}?

Your response will be treated confidentially and shared only with the prospective landlord.

Hi {{1}},

Friendly reminder: your rent of *£{{2}}* for *{{3}}* is due on *{{4}}*.

If you've already arranged payment, please ignore this message. Reply *PAID* once your payment has been sent.

Your *{{1}}* for *{{2}}* is due on *{{3}}*.

Failure to renew may result in fines of {{4}}. I can help you find a certified engineer — just reply *FIND ENGINEER* and I'll search our contractor network.

Type *DONE* once the certificate has been renewed and I'll update your records.

Great news! The screening for *{{1}}* at *{{2}}* is complete.

Screening score: *{{3}}/10* — {{4}}

Your full report is ready. Reply *YES* to approve this tenant, or *NO* to decline.

The report has also been sent to your email.

Your 3 free screenings have been used. To screen *{{1}}* at *{{2}}*, a payment of *£{{3}}* is required.

Click below to pay securely via Stripe:

Hi {{1}},

It's time for your quarterly property inspection at *{{2}}*.

Please send photos of each room (living room, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom(s), and any external areas). Clear, well-lit photos work best.

You have *7 days* to submit — by *{{3}}*.
CompliLet · Your photos are reviewed by AI and your landlord.
